capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EC40 is the C40 Recharge renamed for 2025 and shares the CMA platform, pack and charger with the same-year EX40 (and the XC40/C40 pair before); the EX40 value was read on the cited page. Estimated: Green Car Reports and the Volvo US 2024 release give 82 kWh for the single-motor EX40 in 2024-2025; carried to 2026. Basis for the Canadian Standard: NRCan/EPA rate it 476 km (296 mi), identical to the 2025 single motor, so same pack.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EC40 is the C40 Recharge renamed for 2025 and shares the CMA platform, pack and charger with the same-year EX40 (and the XC40/C40 pair before); the EX40 value was read on the cited page. EV Database (European 82 kWh pack, 108s1p prismatic NMC): 79.0 kWh usable; Volvo UK press (search excerpt) calls the pack 82/79 kWh nominal/usable. Same 82 kWh pack carried from 2024-2025.
